description:
Can the new Lamborghini Temerario take down two 1000hp+ Chinese exports and a supercharged Hayabusa?!

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-2908

How’s this for a line-up?!

We’ve got our hands on four high-performance vehicles, and they’re going head-to-head to see which is fastest! 

Starting off, we’ve got the all-new Lamborghini Huracan going up against the Denza Z9 GT - so let’s check out the stats. 

The Lamborghini Temerario rolls up with a 4-litre twin-turbo V8 and three electric motors. These combine to produce 920hp and 730Nm. It weighs in at 1,790kg, and it costs around £310,000

Then we come to the Denza Z9 GT. It’s a family-sized EV with three electric motors that combine to create 1,156hp and 1,210Nm of torque. It’s super heavy, mind, coming in at 2,875kg, but it’s also much cheaper than the Lambo, costing £105,000.
